thread:
elaine (AE): Quick sync — Novalabs wants a 2-week POC. Primary asks: sample-data access, redaction rules, connectivity (VPC vs hosted), and clear success criteria. Can SE/security weigh in?

mike (SE): I can own tech scope. High level: we can do hosted sandbox with strong redaction, or Dedicated/Private if they need VPC. Need to confirm sample volume and whether PHI/PII present.

sarah (CSM): They're saying ~5k customer transcripts + metadata. Some fields might be PII (emails, phone). They prefer not to upload real PHI to hosted.

jack (Security): Flag: Novalabs' legal requires IP allowlist, KMS integration, and a completed security questionnaire before any data moves. If PHI -> they'd need private deployment or redaction proof.

elaine (AE): Pricing question from them: do we charge hosted usage-only during POC, or does Dedicated deposit apply? They're sensitive to commitments.

mike (SE): For a 2-week eval we recommend hosted (usage billing) + ephemeral sandbox VMs. If they insist on Dedicated for isolation, we need a 30-day lead and committed billing. I can map cost delta.

sarah (CSM): Success criteria they gave: 1) <200ms p95 generation on short prompts, 2) >=85% pass rate on judgement prompts (they'll supply eval set), 3) no data leakage in outputs, 4) basic ML metrics (F1/recall) on reranking flows.

jack (Security): To unblock SQ (security questionnaire) we need: contact for their infosec, copies of sample payloads (sanitized), and confirmation of encryption-in-transit+at-rest. Also provide our SOC2 cert and KMS docs.

elaine (AE): Action items: Mike -> redaction approach + sample config. Jack -> send security checklist + SOC2 link. Sarah -> ask customer for sanitized sample and their eval prompts. I'll handle pricing language.

mike (SE): For redaction I propose we do two layers: client-side tokenization + server-side regex scrub. Example regex we'll ask them to run on their side to sanitize emails/phones:```
(email) /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g
(phone) /(?:\+?\d{1,3}[ \-])?(?:\(?\d{3}\)?[ \-]?)?\d{3}[ \-]?\d{4}/g
```
We can also run a conditional redaction pipeline that replaces matches with <REDACTED> before upload.

mike (SE): Storage options: they can upload sanitized CSV to their S3 and we fetch via presigned URL, or we can spin a short-lived upload bucket in their account (cross-account role). For VPC: we support private endpoints.

jack (Security): If they want data residency in EU, we must pin region and document that data will be in eu-west-1. Also need to confirm retention window for POC artifacts (we recommend auto-delete after 30 days).

elaine (AE): Timeline proposal: Day 0-2: legal & SQ exchange + sample data sanity check. Day 3-5: infra setup (sandbox creds, S3 presigned or cross-account). Day 6-10: run evals and iterate. Day 11-14: wrap, handoff + results + recommended next steps.

sarah (CSM): I'll send them a short questionnaire to collect: sample file format, expected throughput (requests/min), evaluation prompts (CSV), and which fields are absolutely never to be persisted.

elaine (AE): Pricing note to convey: hosted POC billed strictly on usage tokens + ephemeral infra fees (if we provision any), no Dedicated commitment for short POC. If they want committed Dedicated we need to escalate.

mike (SE): Quick config snippet we'll give them for presigned uploads (example):```
POST /presign-upload
headers: { "x-customer-id": "novalabs" }
body: { "path": "poc/novalabs/inputs.csv", "expiry_seconds": 3600 }
```
We'll also provide a sample redaction script (python) if they need it.

jack (Security): I'll attach SOC2 + KMS integration doc in the SQ response. Also ask them for an allowlist of IPs and the contact for their network team.

elaine (AE): Great. Who wants to be point for the week-of-execution?

mike (SE): I'll be on deck for infra and eval runs. @sarah please loop in customer PM and infra contacts.

sarah (CSM): On it. I'll ping them today and aim to get sanitized sample + eval prompts by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-note: sandbox account creation started for novalabs-poc (id: sbx-19753) - ETA ~3 hours

elaine (AE): Perfect — thanks team. I'll draft the POC runbook and pricing note and post here once done.
